Both instances of the office title were corrected to the established Medicine King Hall Master.
The replacement restores the established rendering of 천하제일인 and preserves its distinction from 고금제일인.
The replacement restores the established rendering of 고금제일인 as the greater historical superlative.
The replacement restores Taekyung’s profanity-based mishearing and Wipeng’s immediate correction.
The comparison concerns province-wide scarcity, as confirmed by the following reference to all of Shanxi.
